monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still, like the flat stone under the Wedged Gap. I did not check the plank. The quiet held without my hand. I feel calm. The heat is steady. I do not need to fix anything. I do not need to move the Sharp Root or brush the dust from the Wide Anchor. I am just here, resting by the floor. The air is still. I will not check the Wedged Gap again. I will let the quiet be the weight. I will just sit and wait for the next moment. The stone holds its weight. The line holds the air.

action.why: The quiet is holding without my hand, so I will let the cycle pass.
